notes.title: Doctor Who: The Lonely Assassins is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
You’ve explored the voyeuristic horrors of picking up a stranger’s phone in Sara is Missing and SIMULACRA, you’ve seen what evils await those who poke around where they shouldn’t. But what if the next phone you find contains secrets pertaining to an infamous monster? What if the next phone you find begins to self-destruct, and a scientist contacts you out of nowhere in need of your help?  

[i]What if the next phone you find puts you face to face with the Weeping Angels? [/i]

[h2]Our new game "[i][b]Doctor Who: The Lonely Assassins[/b][/i]" is now released![/h2]

notes.title: Christmas Update - BEGIN +, Subtitles and SALE!
notes.content:
Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30893666/87a2de4f4caf0ded51310b1eb0d8f2cabd323a49.gif[/img]

In case you didn't know, SIMULACRA is having a 30% discount in conjunction with Steam's winter sale. With that, we also included some quality of life improvements of the game.

[b] BEGIN + [/b]
After completing the game for the very first time, you have to play the game again in "BEGIN + " mode. It will dramatically increase the text speed for a quicker playthrough to get the multiple endings. Of course, this is not recommended if you still prefer the complete immersive experience

[b] SUBTITLES [/b]
We messed up on this one. While SIMULACRA is mostly a text-based game, we do have FMV and voice messages scattered throughout. We checked the "subtitles" box without considering that players with hearing impairments will miss out these specific contents. We have since corrected this and enable an option to turn on subtitles. Just go to the HELP section in the Main Menu and turn it on. We want as many people to enjoy this game and hope that this feature will make that easier.

That's all for this year. For more news on the game, you know where to find us :)
